description: Use a finite hand of ballistic stroke cards to intercept drifting elevated cloud greens under changing wind.

metadata.timing_rule: The board and greens hold between decisions. A deliberate card action advances exactly one fixed flight and settles before the next decision; wall-clock waiting does not advance the task.
metadata.variant_count_kind: independent seeded green trajectories, wind, reflection and five difficulty profiles

name: Cloudstep Caddie V2 · Difficulty 1 · Simplified Interaction
natural_language: Use the single CHIP to land inside the drifting cup. The chip flies for 1.2 seconds on this level course. The dotted trail forecasts the cup during the deliberate 1.2-second flight. Aim where the cup will be at landing; the aim coordinate sets bearing and speed, not a tracked target. There is no wind or departure momentum. A missed cup or incomplete certification ends this episode; no retry or world-stop control. Click the CHIP, then click the aim map coordinate to strike. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or any other implementation or hidden-state access. Do not switch to pre-existing, unrelated, blank or browser-settings tabs. Tabs opened by a visible task control are allowed only when part of this task, using their visible controls.
